text: Bitcoin's 1.7% decline paired with Ethereum's milder 0.7% drop signals mild risk-off sentiment, with BTC's larger drawdown suggesting some flight to safety or profit-taking among larger holders. The Fear & Greed index at 10 (extreme fear) and declining 18 points over the week indicates capitulation-level pessimism, though the $74B 24-hour volume remains moderate rather than panic-liquidation territory. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 58.1% despite losses implies the market is not rotating aggressively into altcoins, reflecting cautious positioning overall.
